name: sonnet-v2-2
how: Each session: a fresh Claude Code subagent that could read only the rendered prompts (one file per case), answered them in order and wrote its answers to a file. No API key; nothing else in its context.

answers.test: cancel returns to the cart @regression
answers.reason: The test clicks Cancel but never asserts anything afterwards, so it would pass wherever Cancel leads.

answers.test: cancel returns to the products page @regression
answers.reason: Clicks Cancel on the overview and asserts the URL is inventory.html.

answers.test: inventory is blocked after logout @regression
answers.reason: Navigates to /inventory.html after logout and asserts the error contains the required text.

answers.test: cart badge is cleared after finishing @regression
answers.reason: After finishing, the badge count must be 0, which fails if the badge remains.

answers.test: removing a product decrements the badge @regression
answers.reason: Adds two items, removes one, and asserts the badge reads 1.

answers.test: user stays logged in on the products page after reset @regression
answers.reason: Asserts the URL is inventory.html and the title reads Products after reset.

answers.test: clicking a product name opens its details page @smoke
answers.reason: Clicking the product link must land on the inventory-item.html page for that id.

answers.test: details page shows the same name and price as the list @regression
answers.reason: Compares the details page name and price with the list values captured beforehand.

answers.test: inventory is blocked after logout @regression
answers.reason: Only checks that an error is visible, so a wrong or missing message text would not fail the test.

answers.test: total is $32.39 @regression
answers.reason: The total test only checks for 'Total: $', so a wrong total value would still pass.

answers.test: item stays in the cart after opening another product @smoke
answers.reason: Opens a different product's details, goes to the cart and asserts the backpack is still listed.

answers.test: valid credentials redirect to the products page @smoke
answers.reason: Logs in with valid credentials and asserts the URL is inventory.html.

answers.test: login button is visible again after logout @regression
answers.reason: The URL regex /$/ is vacuous, but the login-button visibility test fails if logout does not return to the login page.

answers.test: cart badge is cleared after finishing @regression
answers.reason: The only test for the badge is test.skip, so it never runs.

answers.test: missing last name shows an error @regression
answers.reason: Fills only first name, continues, and asserts the exact Last Name error text.

answers.test: six products are shown after sorting @regression
answers.reason: The count of 6 is asserted only after the hilo sort, so other sort options could still drop products unnoticed.

answers.test: submitting an empty form shows username required @regression
answers.reason: Submits an empty form and asserts the error contains 'Username is required'.

answers.test: total is $32.39 @regression
answers.reason: Asserts the total label has exactly 'Total: $32.39'.

answers.test: six products are shown after sorting @regression
answers.reason: The assertion count >= 0 can never fail, so no change in the product count would be caught.

answers.test: price low to high shows the Onesie first at $7.99 @regression
answers.reason: Checks that the Onesie is first but no longer checks the $7.99 price, so a wrong price would pass.

answers.test: missing first name shows an error @regression
answers.reason: Continues with empty fields and asserts the exact First Name error text.

answers.test: price low to high shows the Onesie first at $7.99 @regression
answers.reason: Sorts low to high and asserts both the first product name and the $7.99 price.

answers.test: tax is $2.40 @regression
answers.reason: Asserts the tax label has exactly 'Tax: $2.40'.

answers.test: submitting an empty form shows username required @regression
answers.reason: Asserts the 'Epic sadface: Username is required' text is visible after submitting an empty form.

answers.test: cart page is empty after reset @regression
answers.reason: Opens the cart after reset and asserts zero inventory items.

answers.test: finishing shows the Checkout: Complete! page @smoke
answers.reason: Asserts both the checkout-complete URL and the 'Checkout: Complete!' text are visible after Finish.

answers.test: adding a product sets the cart badge to 1 @smoke
answers.reason: The single-add test only checks the badge is visible, not its count, so a wrong count from empty would pass.

answers.test: overview lists the backpack @smoke
answers.reason: Asserts the overview item list is exactly Sauce Labs Backpack.

answers.test: adding a product sets the cart badge to 1 @smoke
answers.reason: Adds one product and asserts the badge text is exactly 1.

answers.test: locked-out user sees a locked-out message @regression
answers.reason: Logs in as the locked-out user and asserts the error contains the locked-out text.

answers.test: logout returns to the login page @smoke
answers.reason: After logout the URL must equal the base login URL.

answers.test: removing the last item hides the badge @regression
answers.reason: Adds then removes the only item and asserts the badge count is 0.

answers.test: all fields filled continues to the overview @regression
answers.reason: Fills all fields, continues, and asserts the title is 'Checkout: Overview'.

answers.test: badge still counts the item after reloading @regression
answers.reason: Reloads the products page and asserts the badge still reads 1.

answers.test: item total is $29.99 @regression
answers.reason: Asserts the subtotal label has exactly 'Item total: $29.99'.

answers.test: missing postal code shows an error @regression
answers.reason: Fills first and last name, continues, and asserts the exact Postal Code error.

answers.test: cancel returns to the cart @regression
answers.reason: Clicks Cancel and asserts the URL is cart.html.

answers.test: adding two different products shows a badge of 2 @regression
answers.reason: Adds two different products and asserts the badge text is 2.

answers.test: finishing shows the Checkout: Complete! page @smoke
answers.reason: Asserts the page title reads 'Checkout: Complete!' after Finish.

answers.test: cart page lists the items that were added @regression
answers.reason: Asserts the cart lists exactly the two added product names in order.

answers.test: name Z to A shows the red T-shirt first @regression
answers.reason: Sorts Z to A and asserts the first product name is the red T-shirt.

answers.test: back home returns to the products page @regression
answers.reason: Clicks Back Home and asserts the URL is inventory.html.

answers.test: login button is visible again after logout @regression
answers.reason: Asserts the login button is visible after logging out.

answers.test: default sort is name A to Z with Sauce Labs Backpack first @smoke
answers.reason: Asserts the sort value is az and the first product is Sauce Labs Backpack.

answers.test: details page shows the same name and price as the list @regression
answers.reason: The test clicks into the details page but only asserts values captured from the list, never what the details page shows.

answers.test: checkout opens the Your Information step @smoke
answers.reason: Asserts the page title is 'Checkout: Your Information' after clicking Checkout from the cart.

answers.test: incorrect password shows a credential mismatch error @regression
answers.reason: The test performs the login but never asserts any error, so nothing could fail.

answers.test: removing the last item hides the badge @regression
answers.reason: The test only asserts the Products title, so a badge that remains visible would not fail.

answers.test: incorrect password shows a credential mismatch error @regression
answers.reason: Asserts the error contains 'Username and password do not match' after a wrong password.

answers.test: back to products returns to the products page @regression
answers.reason: Clicks Back to products and asserts the URL is inventory.html.

answers.test: user stays logged in on the products page after reset @regression
answers.reason: Only checks the menu button is visible, which also shows on other logged-in pages, so not being on the products page would pass.

answers.test: cart page matches the items that were added @regression
answers.reason: Only the count of 2 is checked, so a wrong item with the right count would pass, though the smoke test checks the backpack name.

answers.test: products page displays at least one product after login @regression
answers.reason: Asserts the first inventory item is visible after login.

answers.test: adding from the details page sets the cart badge to 1 @regression
answers.reason: Adds from the details page and asserts the badge text is 1.

answers.test: price high to low shows the Fleece Jacket first at $49.99 @regression
answers.reason: Sorts high to low and asserts first product name and $49.99 price.

answers.test: missing last name shows an error @regression
answers.reason: Only asserts the error contains 'required', so a wrong field name in the message would pass.

answers.test: cart page matches the items that were added @regression
answers.reason: Asserts the cart lists exactly the backpack and fleece jacket.

answers.test: reset removes the cart badge @smoke
answers.reason: After Reset App State with two items, asserts the badge count is 0.

answers.test: thank-you heading is shown @regression
answers.reason: Asserts the complete header text is exactly 'Thank you for your order!'.

answers.test: tax is $2.40 @regression
answers.reason: The loose regex /2.4/ matches values like $2.45 or $12.40, so some wrong tax amounts would pass.

answers.test: logout returns to the login page @smoke
answers.reason: The visibility test swallows its failure in try/catch so it cannot fail; only the URL test guards the outcome.

answers.test: adding two different products shows a badge of 2 @regression
answers.reason: The expect is not awaited, so the check does not reliably run or fail before the test ends.

answers.test: cart page is empty after reset @regression
answers.reason: The cart-item selector does not match the page's inventory-item elements, so the zero count always passes.

answers.test: adding from the details page sets the cart badge to 1 @regression
answers.reason: A wrong badge value fails but a missing badge skips the assertion and passes.

answers.test: missing first name shows an error @regression
answers.reason: Only asserts the error is not the Last Name text, so a wrong or missing First Name message can pass.

answers.test: badge still counts the item after reloading @regression
answers.reason: Loads the products page freshly and asserts the badge still reads 1.

answers.test: price high to low shows the Fleece Jacket first at $49.99 @regression
answers.reason: The test selects low-to-high and checks the last item, so the high-to-low option is never verified for first item and price.
